svg.title: SY70201 application schematic
svg.desc: Application schematic of the SY70201 PMIC (four synchronous bucks, one boost, one load switch), redrawn from the datasheet's page-21 figure. The 3.3 V or 5 V input VIN feeds PVIN1, PVIN2, PVIN3 and PVIN5, each with a 10 µF capacitor (C1, C2, C3, C5) to its own PGND pin. Each buck switch pin SW1, SW2, SW3 and SW5 goes through an inductor (L1 0.47 µH; L2, L3 and L5 0.22 µH) to its output node, which returns to the matching VOUT pin; the outputs have 2 × 47 µF (Buck1 to Buck3: C7 to C12) and 3 × 22 µF (Buck5: C13, C14, C18). The boost runs from VIN through L6 (1 µH) to SW6, with C4 (2.2 µF) from the VIN side of L6 to PGND6; POUT6 and VOUT6 join at the 12 V output with C6 (5 × 4.7 µF) to PGND6. The LSW pin is an output with C17 (1 µF) to ground. AVIN takes VIN through RIN (0 Ω) with C15 (2.2 µF) to AGND, and the LDO pin has C16 (1 µF) to ground. R1 and R2 on SCL and SDA are not fitted (NC) and go to a separate 1.8 or 3.3 V Vcc node. R3, R4 and R5 pull RSTO, PG and EN up to VIN; R6, R7 and R8 pull VSLT, Gate and BK2SEL down to ground. OTP_R has no parts on it.
svg.text: SW4, VOUT4, PVIN4, PGND4: nothing connected
SW6 is two pins (3, 4) and drawn once, as in the datasheet. Pins 12, 13 (NC), 14 (PGND) and the exposed pad are not in the figure.
